+            )

+        duplicates = tuple(sorted({entry_id for entry_id in ids if ids.count(entry_id) > 1}))
+        if duplicates:
+            raise BoundaryContractError(
+                "duplicate_boundary_entry_id",
+                "Boundary contract entry IDs must be unique",
+                ref="BoundaryContract.spec.entries",
+                refs=duplicates,
+                data={"duplicateEntryIds": list(duplicates)},
+            )
+
+
+def boundary_contract_from_value(
+    value: Any,
+    *,
+    goal_ref: str,
+    fallback_text: str | None = None,
+) -> BoundaryContract:
+    if isinstance(value, BoundaryContract):
+        return value
+    if value is None:
+        if fallback_text:
+            return BoundaryContract.from_text(goal_ref=goal_ref, text=fallback_text)
+        raise BoundaryContractError(
+            "missing_boundary_contract",
+            "Frozen alignment must include a boundary contract",
+            ref="agentOutput.boundaryContract",
+        )
+    if isinstance(value, Mapping):
+        data = dict(value)
+        if "metadata" not in data and "goalRef" not in data:
+            data["goalRef"] = goal_ref
+        return BoundaryContract.from_mapping(data)
+    if isinstance(value, Sequence) and not isinstance(value, (str, bytes, bytearray)):
+        return BoundaryContract.from_entries(goal_ref=goal_ref, entries_data=value)
+    raise BoundaryContractError(
+        "invalid_boundary_contract",
+        "Boundary contract must be a mapping or list of boundary entries",
+        ref="agentOutput.boundaryContract",
+    )
+
+
+def _required_string(data: Mapping[str, Any], key: str, ref: str) -> str:
+    value = data.get(key)
+    if not isinstance(value, str) or not value.strip():
+        raise BoundaryContractError("missing_boundary_string", f"{key} must be a non-empty string", ref=ref)
+    return value
+
+
+def _optional_string(value: Any) -> str | None:
+    if value is None:
+        return None
+    text = str(value).strip()
+    return text or None
+
+
+def _mapping(value: Any, ref: str) -> Mapping[str, Any]:
+    if not isinstance(value, Mapping):
+        raise BoundaryContractError("invalid_boundary_mapping", f"{ref} must be a mapping", ref=ref)
+    return value
+
+
+__all__ = [
+    "BoundaryContract",
+    "BoundaryContractError",
+    "BoundaryEntry",
+    "BoundaryEntryKind",
+    "boundary_contract_from_value",
+]
